definitions: A person who strings something, especially a tennis racket.
A freelance journalist or photographer who contributes to a newspaper, magazine, or news agency.
A long horizontal timber or steel beam used to support a floor, road, or railway track.
A long, thin piece of material, such as a strip of wood or metal.
examples: He works as a stringer for a national newspaper.
The stringer on the bridge needed replacing.
The boat had a new stringer installed.
